parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the WAF rule group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. This parameter is required when you create a custom WAF rule group.

parameters.name: Subscribe
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to subscribe to the rule group. Valid values:

- **on**: The subscription is enabled.
- **off**: The subscription is disabled.

Do not specify this parameter when you copy another custom rule group.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the rule group to copy. This parameter is required when you copy a custom WAF rule group. You can call the [DescribeDcdnWafGroups](~~DescribeDcdnWafGroups~~) operation to query the ID of the rule group. If you do not use a template, set this parameter to 0 or leave it unspecified.
